description: Current MLE scripts request median and reject the MAGeCK 0.5.9.5 total fallback. Lau changed from total; other MLE normalization settings are unchanged. Tuano B80-T5/B80-T17 cell-line labels corrected without changing sample selection or design matrices. No study was rerun for this update.
run_evidence: Full run logs and completed MLE result tables have not been archived in this repository. This snapshot does not establish which outputs entered the manuscript.
validation: Five normalization regression tests pass, covering all four current MLE scripts and the RRA log helper.

The unmodified official MAGeCK 0.5.9.5 normalizer was checked on synthetic tables with 0%, 35%, 45%, 46% and 82% zero guides in one sample; preflight and log guards agree with its actual median/total choice.
Dry runs on synthetic dense tables produce nine median commands and the same nine checked-in design matrices.
All shell scripts pass bash -n. Original command records and the archived Lin script are unchanged.
No full MLE or RRA fit was performed and no historical output was relabelled as median-normalized.

previous_snapshot.description: Python scripts copied byte-for-byte from the versions supplied for MLE reanalysis. Static design matrices were generated from their make_design functions.
validation: Five Python files parse and match the supplied source bytes.
Nine current design matrices have unique sample rows, full column rank and the declared treatment contrast.
Clements input preparation and the original MAGeCK 0.5.9.5 count loader were previously checked on both 77441-guide exports; no MLE fit was performed for this upload.
